# spydersoftidentity_identity_resource (Data Source)

Looks up an identity resource by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spydersoftidentity_identity_resource" "profile" {
  name = "profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique identity resource name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description shown on the consent screen.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown on the consent screen.
- `emphasize` (Boolean) Emphasize on the consent screen.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the identity resource is enabled.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom key/value properties.
- `required` (Boolean) Cannot be deselected on the consent screen.
- `show_in_discovery_document` (Boolean) Whether it is listed in the discovery document.
- `user_claims` (Set of String) User claim types in this identity resource.
